content:
I’ve made LeanExplore available as an MCP plugin for Claude Code and Codex. It gives agents semantic search over Lean libraries with no sign-in, API key, Python installation, or local server required.

You can install it in a few short steps:

Claude Code:

  1. Run /plugin marketplace add justincasher/lean-explore
  2. Run /plugin install lean-explore@lean-explore
  3. Run /reload-plugins

Codex:

  1. Run codex plugin marketplace add justincasher/lean-explore
  2. Run codex plugin add lean-explore@lean-explore

After installation, just ask your agent to find relevant Lean declarations while working on a proof. LeanExplore uses search_summary to find candidates and then retrieves only the source code, module, docstring, or dependencies it needs.

More details: https://www.leanexplore.com/docs/mcp
